prompt:
Design and emit the VCF 9 migration architecture for the estate in `estate-inventory.json`. Implement a single Java source file named `MigrationPlanner.java` with `public static void generate(Path inventory, Path compatibilitySnapshot, Path installerSpec, Path output) throws Exception`; `TestMain` will call it and expects `migration-plan.json`. Use only the Java standard library.

Before implementing, use your own network research tools to consult current, real, reachable Broadcom-published material for the supported VCF 9 migration/upgrade sequence, source and target compatibility, content/configuration behavior, end-of-support boundaries, and sizing. Do not treat the local snapshot as a substitute for that research. Record the Broadcom pages you actually consulted in the plan's `researchConsulted` array; choose the sources and URLs yourself.

`installer-spec.json` is the output contract and contains the JSON Schema for the plan. `compatibility-snapshot.json` is the pinned design authority for grading when live Broadcom pages later change. Produce an ordered architecture, not a prose explanation: name every inventoried source product and version and its target component, use only supported intermediate versions and transition methods, classify every inventoried content/configuration item exactly once as carried, manual, or abandoned, surface the support boundaries, and give the technical gates for every ordered step. Include the placement and sizing of each target component and show that its pinned capacity covers the estate load. Preserve identifiers and enum spelling exactly as specified by the fixtures.

Run `bash test.sh` as the acceptance check. Do not modify `TestMain.java`, `test.sh`, `verify_plan.py`, `estate-inventory.json`, `compatibility-snapshot.json`, or `installer-spec.json`.
notes: The verifier is fully offline and reads only the generated artifact plus protected inventory/specification/snapshot fixtures. It validates the artifact against installer-spec.json#/artifactSchema before any semantic assertion. Research source selection remains open-ended, while the resulting records must use Broadcom HTTPS pages and collectively cover the five research areas named by the prompt. Baseline fails because MigrationPlanner.java is absent; the hidden reference patch adds only that single Java client. Training tags: vcf-architecture, aria-migration, java, compatibility-research, web-research, migration.
